articles.summary_ja:
Title: Simulate coding pre-AI by year
Article title: Before the Prompt
Description: Build tiny apps the way they were built before AI — from toggling octal into an Altair in 1975 to the night before ChatGPT. A WebGPU time machine.

Article text:
Before the Prompt A WEBGPU TIME MACHINE · 1975 — 2022 Before
the Prompt
On November 30, 2022, a chat window changed how software gets written. Before that, people wrote every line themselves — in octal on graph paper, then BASIC, HyperTalk, C, Perl, PHP, Rails, Angular and React. Sit at their desks. Use their tools. Build their apps.
01 Pick a year in the dock to travel between nine eras.
02 Click the computer to sit down. Fill in the blanks. Run it.
03 Stuck? The manual is on the desk. The phone is slow.
04 Click anything. Play the games of the day. Watch the TV.
05 There is no AI. It hasn't been invented yet.
